# The standard library in readable Chord form (ADR-265)

**REFERENCE ONLY — generated, do not edit.** Regenerate with
`node scripts/generate-stdlib-chord.js`. Each `.story` here is a Chord-form
rendering of one standard action, carrying `reference-only: true` — it compiles,
but `sharpee` refuses to run it. The real implementation is TypeScript in
`packages/stdlib/`. This is a projection, not a port (ADR-265 D5).
